notes.title: 1.1 Curses and Blessings
notes.notes:
Howdy! Since launch we have been working to diligently fix anything reported and react to played feedback but now we have something better than fixes and tweaks! Welcome to the first content patch of Veritus.

-Added curses // Curses are unlocked by completing feats and  can be enabled in Memoria once you have beaten the game once.
-Added blessings // Blessings are unlocked by completing feats and  can be enabled in Memoria once you have beaten the game once.
-Added storehouse // Do you have that Ice Key? Well I hope so! Challenge a seemingly endless series of floors collecting loot and fending off enemies. The lower you go the more enemies but the more loot you will see.  Escape before you die to collect all your gathered loot. This content will allow you to farm a LOT of materials very quickly depending on your luck to encourage more crafting and experimentation.
-new lore books // These will be found in the Storehouse 
-a new legendary equip has slipped into the game // Don’t worry about it.
-new songs // Duh
-Guide Boots now protect from nipper damage // Forgive me?
-new ending for those willing to brave curses // It is worth it.
-typos // Always
-tiles // =)
-Fixed skeleton sprite anchoring 
-Adjusted multiple boss hitboxes
-buffed fist damage // Fist now is the highest per hit damage of all weapons to make up for it being so slow.
-adjusted player luck // You’ll need it in the storehouse
-keys can no longer be gambled from Zaegul’s bag // I’m not sorry.

As always we will be quickly working to react to feedback and issues with the update. While we work very hard to test and make sure out releases are clean and solid please forgive our dust.

Thanks,
-Mhinbron

notes.title: VERITUS ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK RELEASE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44424641/b27b67b9fc3bdc307a7cf47b585ad64d8dee0924.png[/img]

[h2]The Veritus Original Soundtrack is Out Now![/h2]

After a bit of hassle and a long wait, we are happy to announce that you can now purchase the OST for Veritus on Steam for your library! John did an incredible job on the music for this game, so we are all very excited for the community at large to be able to listen to it on the go.

This time around there are a total of 78 tracks including all of the tracks that made it into the game, PLUS a few bonus, unused songs that we couldn't bear to thow away.

We hope you enjoy!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3102980/Veritus_Soundtrack/
